notes.title: Progress update 3 (June 2022)
notes.notes:
😃 We finished new Demon - check it in this video
[previewyoutube=q1AH4X7AX64;full][/previewyoutube]

😃 New items are ready. And a little more about it. There is 6 types of items in game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778909/f6e9fad65050a56348f39395f2659e9a9a37137a.jpg

Move yourself - items of this type increase the mobility of the hunter.
Move objects - Allows you to move other units or objects to an unexpected place for them.
Throwing - can be used at a distance. A good way to reach out to an unsuspecting enemy.
Drug (or medicament)- drugs strengthen the hunter who used them.
Stationary - placed on the battlefield and waiting for their moment.
Other devices - are a special item with a unique effect.


😃 Ready icons for the hunter Oleg

😃 Finally - an epic video with the Bloodsucker demon (WOOOW)
[previewyoutube=sRUhbX_gBVI;full][/previewyoutube]

And we still have an active campaign on Kicksterter - check it out and support us there!

notes.title: Work progress update
notes.notes:
👉🏻Battle royale to be!
We didn’t plan to include this mode at the release stage, but we realized that this mode will make the project more interesting.
Hunters will compete with each other. And places of demons one by one will be taken by those who drop out of this fight. The game is on until the last (single) surviving hunter.
Two types of maps are planned - for 4 players and standard for 8.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778909/f297c203f90857d201ab640833adb45b779db694.jpg

👉🏻A new zone 
This is the toxic zone of the Royal battle mode. The toxic zone gradually grows and fills the map, reducing the non-toxic zone. If hunters are in a toxic zone, they get damage. This gas may also works on demons - the government released it in order to stop the demons. And with the hope of stopping the invasion

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778909/3acda8ee415f50440226fd6bf68ed71aa21bf123.jpg

👉🏻A new monster
Already in the work of the 3D modelers - Bloodsucker. Abilities - Hypnosis and Poisonous Blood. Sounds great!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41778909/e034774d7ce2b62b43bc4ddc6036f187f531858d.jpg

👉🏻Voiceovers
The voiceovers for almost all Hunters is completed. Defenders of Humanity will speak Afrikaans, Japanese, German, Russian, British and American English.
